Marissa / Ben — reviewed BrightWave's request. Finance position: we can approve Net60 on milestone invoices for this deal with the following controls:

- Require the 50% upfront to be collected at execution and to be nonrefundable (applied as prepaid credit).
- For the 12-month true-up and renewal invoice, apply Net60 payment terms but put a 10% retention hold that becomes payable only after payment clears or at the end of the 60-day window — essentially a performance reserve. This mitigates credit risk while providing them the Net60 they want.
- Include a clause that any unpaid milestone invoice after Net60 will trigger temporary suspension of new capacity expansions and a freeze on price tiers (no retroactive discounts).

Accounting note: we can recognize revenue against the prepaid credit as usage occurs; the retention hold will be kept as a contractual receivable. Legal will need to redline the SOW to include the retention and suspension language. If Marketing wants to push an extra discount to compensate, that will need a margin approval.

If this approach is acceptable, I'll ask Legal to prepare a short amendment to the SOW that lists the payment schedule, retention percentage, and the Net60 milestone term.

-Karthik
